parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and UTC time is used. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

parameters.name: StageName
parameters.description:
The environment in which the API runs. Valid values:

*   **RELEASE**: the production environment
*   **PRE**: the pre-release environment
*   **TEST: the test environment**

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and UTC time is used. Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudapi describe-instance-traffic --start-time 2022-03-31T03:42:00Z --end-time 2022-04-01T06:34:03Z --stage-name RELEASE --instance-id apigateway-cn-2r426lavr001 --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
